spec_match.rationale: Three sibling files with identical contents, differing only in the router source their full pathname is bound to. Which side served each request is read from a response header the fetch handler sets, not inferred from the timing being explained.

interactive.rationale: A repetition count and a measure button; results as bars and a table with the served-by attribution beside each timing.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The page says twice that the handler's delay is chosen rather than measured, and why: a real bootstrap cost is small, noisy and machine-specific.

edge_cases.rationale: An uncontrolled page is detected and explained rather than producing meaningless numbers; identical payload sizes are asserted before the timings are compared.

references.rationale: chromestatus.com/feature/5194817700364288 and the addRoutes specification section.

conformance.rationale: Three concept-level assertions: a synthesised Response can carry the attribution header, registration is available, and performance.now is monotonic.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Measured in Chrome 150: 1.1ms via the network route, 223ms through a handler that delays 220ms by design, 1.7ms via the race, with identical 1944-byte payloads and the served-by header confirming the network lane never woke the handler.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits the three lane timings and their served-by values.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, button colour pairs, 44px controls, table in its own scroll container.

accessibility.rationale: Bars carry their values as text; the table has row headers; results announced through aria-live.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Bar rows use minmax first columns so labels wrap; the table scrolls in its own container.

openQuestions.title: The handler delay is chosen, not measured
openQuestions.detail: A real cold-start cost would be the honest number, and getting one needs a way to evict a running worker that a page does not have. The page states the substitution rather than hiding it.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive bar chart rows without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give bar rows an intrinsic minimum first column so labels wrap rather than pushing the track off-screen.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Bar rows use minmax(10ch, 16ch); the lane table sits in an overflow-x:auto wrapper.

summary: The shape is real even though the magnitude is chosen: a request routed to the network never reaches the worker, so nothing the worker does can slow it down.
